command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p out/t3
python3 - <<'IDENTITY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
roots={x:pathlib.Path(x) for x in ['agent','runtime','app','pinokio']}
ident={x:{'head':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(p),'rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'tree':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(p),'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'],text=True).strip(),'status':subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(p),'status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()} for x,p in roots.items()}
ident['app_manifest_sha256']=hashlib.sha256((roots['app']/'public/install-manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
ident['runtime_lock_sha256']=hashlib.sha256((roots['agent']/'requirements/runtime.lock').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
ident['installed_product_digest']=None
ident['installed_product_note']='Editable source test environment; no installed-product digest claimed.'
pathlib.Path('out/t3/identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(ident,indent=2)+'\n')
IDENTITY
curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v20.19.4/node-v20.19.4-linux-x64.tar.gz -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/t04-node.tgz"
printf '%s  %s\n' d80a33707605ced9a31b8f543cea9ab512bc3d2fef2c148f31a50e939ff07560 "$RUNNER_TEMP/t04-node.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/t04-node.tgz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
export PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/node-v20.19.4-linux-x64/bin:$PATH"
test "$(node --version)" = v20.19.4
test "$(npm --version)" = 10.8.2
python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/t04-venv"
V="$RUNNER_TEMP/t04-venv/bin/python"
"$V" -m pip install -e 'agent[dev]'
"$V" -m pip install --no-deps -e runtime -e runtime/packages/python
"$V" -c 'import runtime_protocol; from pathlib import Path; p=Path(runtime_protocol.__file__).resolve(); print("runtime_protocol",p); assert p.is_relative_to(Path("runtime").resolve())'
npm ci --prefix agent/remotion --no-audit --no-fund
(cd agent/remotion && npx remotion browser ensure)
npm ci --prefix app --no-audit --no-fund
(cd app && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium)
sudo apt-get update
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --reinstall ffmpeg
{
  dpkg-query -W -f='${Package} ${Version} ${Architecture}\n' ffmpeg
  for binary in ffmpeg ffprobe; do
    path="$(command -v "$binary")"
    printf '%s path=%s resolved=%s\n' "$binary" "$path" "$(readlink -f "$path")"
    sha256sum "$path"
    "$path" -version
  done
} | tee out/t3/media-tools.txt
export ASTRID_T3_EVIDENCE_DIR="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/out/t3/evidence"
export ASTRID_TIMELINE_SCHEMA_PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/agent/astrid/core/timeline/schema/timeline-config.schema.json"
python3 - <<'SCHEMA_IDENTITY'
import hashlib,json,os,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(os.environ['ASTRID_TIMELINE_SCHEMA_PYTHONPATH']).resolve(strict=True)
digest=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pathlib.Path('out/t3/schema-identity.json').write_text(json.dumps({'environment_variable':'ASTRID_TIMELINE_SCHEMA_PYTHONPATH','resolved_path':str(p),'sha256':digest},indent=2)+'\n')
assert digest == 'f870150ffd0e42365c048965e2f7c08efc959c36db76ed4cba59de2e58ab4e08', 'unexpected Agent schema identity'
SCHEMA_IDENTITY
cd agent
set +e
"$V" -m pytest -o addopts= -vv -rA --basetemp="$RUNNER_TEMP/t04-pytest" --junitxml=../out/t3/results.xml tests/integrations/test_pinned_element_render_proof.py::test_pinned_element_render_proof_on_standin > ../out/t3/pytest.log 2>&1
rc=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$rc" > ../out/t3/inner-exit.txt
export TEST_EXIT="$rc"
set +e
python3 - <<'DIAGNOSTICS'
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, re, tempfile

out = pathlib.Path('../out/t3/diagnostics')
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
roots = [('failed-validation', pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 't04-pytest', 'failed-validation-*.json'), ('probe-stderr', pathlib.Path(tempfile.gettempdir()) / 'astrid-probe-logs', '*.stderr.log')]
manifest = {'limits': {'files_per_kind': 16, 'bytes_per_file': 65536}, 'kinds': {}}
# Diagnostic output is untrusted: redact environment values and credential-like lines.
values = sorted({v for v in os.environ.values() if len(v) >= 8 and '\n' not in v}, key=len, reverse=True)
def scrub(s):
    for value in values:
        s = s.replace(value, '[ENV_REDACTED]')
    s = re.sub(r'(?i)(https?://)[^\s/@]+:[^\s/@]+@', r'\1[REDACTED]@', s)
    s = re.sub(r'(?im)^.*(?:authorization|bearer\s+|api[_-]?key|password|passwd|secret|token|credential|private[_ -]?key|cookie).*(?:\n|$)', '[SENSITIVE LINE REDACTED]\n', s)
    return s
for kind, root, pattern in roots:
    result = {'root': str(root), 'matched': 0, 'retained': [], 'errors': [], 'omitted_over_limit': 0}
    manifest['kinds'][kind] = result
    try:
        files = sorted(p for p in root.rglob(pattern) if p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink()) if root.exists() else []
        result['matched'] = len(files)
        result['omitted_over_limit'] = max(0, len(files) - 16)
        for i, path in enumerate(files[:16]):
            try:
                size = path.stat().st_size
                with path.open('rb') as stream:
                    raw = stream.read(65536)
                item = {'source_relative': str(path.relative_to(root)), 'source_bytes': size, 'captured_prefix_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), 'truncated': size > len(raw)}
                text = scrub(raw.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
                # Failed validation contains a receipt which can include argv and environment.
                # Preserve the fixed diagnostic fields and a scrubbed probe check, not raw custody data.
                if kind == 'failed-validation':
                    record = json.loads(raw) if size <= len(raw) else {}
                    safe = {k: record.get(k) for k in ('schema', 'status', 'error_type', 'probe_check', 'retained_original_child_pid', 'cleanup_uncertain')}
                    safe['original_probe_receipt_present'] = record.get('original_probe_receipt') is not None
                    text = scrub(json.dumps(safe, indent=2, sort_keys=True)) + '\n'
                name = f'{kind}-{i:02d}' + ('.json' if kind == 'failed-validation' else '.log')
                (out / name).write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
                item['retained_as'] = name
                item['retained_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256((out / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                result['retained'].append(item)
            except Exception as exc:
                result['errors'].append({'source_relative': str(path.relative_to(root)), 'error_type': type(exc).__name__})
    except Exception as exc:
        result['errors'].append({'error_type': type(exc).__name__})
    result['absence'] = 'no matching files found' if not result['matched'] and not result['errors'] else None
(out / 'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n')
DIAGNOSTICS
capture_rc=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$capture_rc" > ../out/t3/diagnostics-capture-exit.txt
python3 - <<'RETAIN'
import json,os,pathlib,shutil
out=pathlib.Path('../out/t3'); root=pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'t04-pytest'
for name in ('export-frames','preview-frames','builtin-baseline'):
 for i,p in enumerate(root.rglob(name)):
  if p.is_dir(): shutil.copytree(p,out/'visuals'/name/str(i),dirs_exist_ok=True)
data={'inner_exit':int(os.environ['TEST_EXIT']),'groups':{'1':'two pinned revisions, colors and source digests','2':'missing/corrupt snapshot rejection','3':'built-in baseline unchanged','4':'preview/export frames 5,15,25 within asserted tolerance'},'mapping_only':True,'fixture_limitations':['occurrence video is image-only','voice fixtures are silent']}
(out/'group-map.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n')
RETAIN
exit "$rc"
